individual-data-points.explanation: Stacked bar/area chart shows median state frequency across many contiguous Pol II ChIP-seq bins, functioning as a trend/distribution display similar to a line plot; overlaying individual promoter values across ~n=5912 promoters and dozens of bins would be unreadable and is not the standard expectation for this plot type.

Each row of the single-molecule stack represents an individual DNA molecule's methylation pattern, so the underlying individual data points (molecules) are directly displayed rather than only a summary statistic.

Same stacked bar/area trend representation as panel A (mouse data), showing median state frequency across binned Pol II ChIP-seq levels; not a simple categorical bar-of-means plot requiring point overlay.
Each row depicts an individual molecule's methylation status, i.e., the raw individual data underlying the summarized state percentages are shown directly.
Box plot already displays the data distribution (median, IQR, whiskers, and outlier points), so overlay of individual points is not required.
